messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detected anomaly: aggregated_gpu_vram_pressure AND gpu_ecc_spike on cluster-east-1 (nodes: 12,13,14)
pagerduty: Paging Nadia (oncall)
Nadia: seeing it, opening thread. cluster dashboard looks noisy across a rack. bringing up per-node metrics now
SRE-Infra: raw metrics: node-12 ecc_correctable increased by 18 in 6m, node-13 by 15, node-14 by 2. VRAM pct > 88% on nodes 12/13. temps hovering 72-79C.
Tom: routing: some requests got 504s from model-beta. autoscaler started new workers but they hot-started slowly. brief customer impact recorded.
InfraOps: preliminary: nodes show elevated ECC and VRAM; driver restarts on node-12 before alerts; nv_peer_cache reports errors too.
Nadia: immediate mitigations: 1) mark nodes 12/13 schedulable=false; 2) trigger warm pool spin-up for model-beta; 3) enable fallback routing to dedicated-pool for affected tenants. Doing cordon+drain now.
SRE-Infra: drain in progress: using graceful 90s drain to avoid OOMs; migrating stateful pods to cold pool where applicable
SupportBot: creating incident record INC-2026-46, severity P1 (multi-node impact)
Tom: customer telemetry: 9 tenants had 95p latency spikes, 3 tenants had generation errors ~2-6min window. status page draft queued.
Nadia: vendor diag requested; tagging InfraOps and hardware-oncall. asking for vendor loop-up and serial numbers for nodes 12/13.
InfraOps: vendor engaged. ETA 30m for remote diagnostics; onsite if replacement required. posting hardware ticket HT-7892.
Nadia: quick note on alerts: the pager fired because aggregate rule matched, but we also had two independent pager alerts earlier from single-node ECC on node-21 at 1781238000 which cluttered the oncall. we need clearer thresholding.
SRE-Infra: suggested alert scheme (proposal):

```
# recording rule
gpu_ecc_rate = increase(gpu_ecc_correctable_total[5m])

# pager (P1)
ALERT RackGPUHardwareFault
  IF sum by(rack)(gpu_ecc_rate > 10 and node_gpu_vram_used_pct > 85) >= 2
  FOR 5m
  LABELS { severity="P1" }
  ANNOTATIONS { runbook="runbooks/gpu_hardware_fault.md" }

# single-node ops visibility (slack only)
ALERT NodeGPUEccNotice
  IF gpu_ecc_rate > 3 FOR 1m
  ANNOTATIONS { notify_channel="#gpu-alerts" }
```

Nadia: this would reduce pager noise for single-node flukes and escalate only on multi-node/rack correlation
Tom: also want VRAM-pressure to suppress when training.label=heavy_training OR cluster.mode==training for 10m windows to avoid false positives during scheduled retrains
InfraOps: agree. we'll add suppression using alertmanager inhibition rules and a label matcher for job=training-run
Nadia: dashboards: need a heatmap view showing per-gpu VRAM % across the rack, a stacked ECC event timeline, and an evacuation timeline for drains. also add an annotation stream for driver restarts, vendor diag, and kube-drain events
SRE-Infra: runbook gaps: current runbook assumes single-node failure. add section: multi-node escalation -> page infra lead + on-call manager, and immediate customer-facing messaging template for P1 hardware incidents
DevEx: will prepare a status page snippet:

"We are investigating increased latency for some model endpoints. A subset of GPU nodes are reporting memory-correctable ECC events and high VRAM usage; we have initiated failover and are working with the hardware vendor. Expected mitigation window: 30-60 minutes."

Tom: mitigation update: warm pool added, traffic shifted, tail latency improving but still elevated for heavy batch jobs.
InfraOps: vendor remote diag indicates possible memory module degradation on nodes 12/13. recommend replacing DIMMs if ECC persists after cold reboot.
Nadia: action items while oncall:
- InfraOps -> implement pager aggregation rule and add alertmanager inhibition for training windows (PR link when open)
- SRE-Infra -> update runbook for multi-node hardware incidents (draft by EOD)
- DevEx -> post initial status page, update if vendor confirms hardware replacement (ASAP)
- SupportBot -> tag affected tenants and include mitigation steps (by next 15m)

SRE-Infra: opened PR: https://git.company/repo/alerts/pull/312 (will add tests and dashboards)
InfraOps: PR created for suppression rules, assigning reviewers
Nadia: handoff: I will monitor for 25 more minutes then hand off to Tom at 1781240300. key watch items: reappearance of ECC after cold reboot, VRAM convergence below 70%, vendor confirm on DIMM replacement
Tom: ack, i'll pick up. set alert mute for the non-pager slack-only ECC notices to reduce noise during recovery
SupportBot: status page posted: "Mitigation in progress; we have rerouted traffic and engaged hardware vendor"
Nadia: final note: post-incident we should add a synthetic test that writes/reads to GPU memory to catch pre-failure ECC growth and also a nightly check that aggregates ECC rates by rack to catch slow degradation
DevEx: will add customer-facing postmortem template to the runbook and coordinate tenant follow-ups
incident-bot: Handoff: Nadia -> Tom at 1781240300. current severity: P1 -> monitoring as warm pool stable and vendor engaged :white_check_mark:
Tom: taking over monitoring. continuing to watch ECC rate and VRAM heatmap. will post PR links and dashboard URLs once merged.
